title: 36 Hours in Williamsburg, Va.
abstract: In recent years, this historic town’s Colonial District has become an upscale experience with high-quality wines, lavish spas and fancy Southern cuisine.

title: 36 Hours in Research Triangle, N.C.
abstract: The close-knit cities of Raleigh, Durham and Chapel Hill occupy a happy place between slow-paced Southern charm and urban cool.

title: 36 Hours in Malibu
abstract: The staggering natural beauty of the sea and mountains is obvious, but pull off the road and stay awhile, and you’ll find local wines and chic shops.

title: 36 Hours in Cork, Ireland
abstract: The city’s compact size makes it perfect for a tour on foot, providing you’ve packed walking shoes and a bit of ambition for a few hilly climbs.
